dedupe_keys.name: highways agency network journey time and traffic flow data

description: Highways Agency network journey time and traffic flow data is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Highways. The latest journey time and traffic data is now available at This data series provides average journey time, speed and traffic flow information for 15-minute periods since April 2009 on all morotways and 'A' roads managed by the Highways Agency, known as the Strategic Road Network, in England. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher National Highways. The portal shows 2025-01-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
